// Displaces a surface by a scalar field: Source indexes a caller-supplied
// list of spatial scalar fields whose value, scaled by Amplitude, offsets
// the distance. The result is NOT a bound — adding the displacement inflates
// distances as readily as it shrinks them; `ApplyToDistance` in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato` carries the factor that recovers a lower bound.
type SdfDisplacementModifier3D
    implements IValue
{
    Source: ItemIndex;
    Amplitude: Number;
}
